get.summary:
`GET /api/v1/avatars/{file}`: a profile photo, public and cacheable for
good, `200`.
`GET /api/v1/jobs`: one page of the jobs, newest first, `200`.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description:
Only the jobs with this status: `pending` (waiting, or running) or
`dead` (out of attempts). Every status when absent.

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: Only the jobs of this kind, such as `mail.send`.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: The jobs a page holds, 1 to 100. Defaults to 20.

400.description: A malformed query

delete.summary: `DELETE /api/v1/jobs/{id}`: cancels a pending or dead job, `204`.

409.description: A worker is running it right now

post.summary:
`POST /api/v1/jobs/{id}/retry`: puts a dead job back in the queue, due
now with its attempts at zero, `204`.

404.description: No dead job has this id

get.summary: `GET /api/v1/media`: one page of the caller's files, newest first, `200`.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: The files a page holds, 1 to 100. Defaults to 20.

400.description: A malformed query

post.summary:
`POST /api/v1/media`: stores the raw body as one of the caller's files,
`201`. The file name is `?filename=`, or else the `X-Filename` header.

parameters.name: filename
parameters.description: The file's original name, kept for display and as the download name.

requestBody.description: The raw file bytes. The type is detected from the bytes; the request's Content-Type is ignored

400.description: An empty body

415.description: Unrecognized file type, or one that is not allowed

post.summary:
`POST /api/v1/media/uploads`: starts a direct upload, `201`. The client
sends the bytes with `method` to `upload_url`, with `headers`, then
completes it; until then the file is no one's to read.

201.description: Where to put the bytes, and until when

415.description: A type that is not allowed

422.description: An invalid body, or a file name over 255 characters

400.description: A malformed id

404.description: No such file, or it belongs to someone else

delete.summary: `DELETE /api/v1/media/{id}`: deletes one of the caller's files, `204`.

400.description: A malformed id

404.description: No such file, or it belongs to someone else

post.summary:
`POST /api/v1/media/{id}/complete`: completes a direct upload, `200`,
once its bytes are up and match what was declared.

404.description: No such upload, or it expired or belongs to someone else

409.description: The bytes have not been uploaded yet

422.description: The bytes are not the size or type declared; the upload is removed

get.summary:
`GET /api/v1/media/{id}/content`: the bytes of one of the caller's
files, `200`, with the detected `Content-Type`. Only an image is shown
inline; anything else downloads, and `nosniff` and a sandboxing CSP
keep the browser from treating it as anything else.

200.description: The file's bytes, with the detected Content-Type

400.description: A malformed id

404.description: No such file, or it belongs to someone else

get.summary:
`GET /api/v1/media/{id}/url`: a short-lived URL one of the caller's

404.description: No such file, or it belongs to someone else

`GET /api/v1/storage/{token}`: the bytes under the key an API-signed

put.summary:
`PUT /api/v1/storage/{token}`: stores the raw body under the key an
API-signed upload URL grants, `204`. The token is the credential.

ApiKeyResponse.description: An API key as the list answers it: never the key itself.

expires_at.description: When the key stops working, if ever.

key_prefix.description: First characters of the key, to recognise it in a list. The full key is never shown again.

last_used_at.description: When the key was last used (to the minute).

AuditLogEntryResponse.description: A `audit_log` row as the API answers it.

ChangeEmailDto.description:
`POST /auth/email/change`'s body. The new email is trimmed and
lowercased before it is checked.

new_email.description: The address to move the account to.

ChangePasswordDto.description: `POST /auth/password/change`'s body: the password now and the new one.

new_password.description: The new password: 8 to 128 characters, anything allowed.

expires_in_days.description: Omit for a key that never expires.

name.description: What the key is for, 1 to 100 characters after trimming.

oneOf.description: `read` (default): safe HTTP methods only. `write`: everything an API key may do.

allOf.description: The key as the list shows it.

key.description: Send it as `Authorization: Bearer <key>` or `X-API-Key: <key>`. Store it now.

CreatedApiKeyResponse.description: Returned once, when the key is created: the only time the secret is visible.

CredentialsDto.description:
`POST /auth/register`'s and `POST /auth/login`'s body. The email is
trimmed and lowercased before it is checked.

password.description: The password: 8 to 128 characters, anything allowed.

DisableTotpDto.description:
`POST /auth/2fa/disable`'s body. Requires the current password so a
stolen session token alone cannot turn off two-factor.

DownloadUrl.description:
`GET /media/{id}/url`'s answer: a short-lived URL the file's bytes can
be fetched from without credentials.

url.description: The URL: absolute on an S3-compatible store, else relative to the API.

EnableTotpDto.description: `POST /auth/2fa/enable`'s body: a code from the authenticator app.

ErrorBody.description:
The wire standard's error body: `{"error": {"code", "message",
"details"?}}`. Any error answer can use it, not only a rejected body.

code.description:
A `snake_case` code for programs, such as `BAD_REQUEST`,
`PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE` or `VALIDATION_FAILED`.

details.description:
The broken validation rules by field path, `{"path": [{"code",
"message", "params"}]}`, when there are any.

ForgotPasswordDto.description:
`POST /auth/password/forgot`'s body. The email is trimmed and
lowercased before it is checked.

InviteUserDto.description:
`POST /auth/invitations`' body: an admin invites someone, whose account
is created and a "set your password" link mailed. The email is trimmed
and lowercased, the display name trimmed (an empty one is none), and
the role is `user` unless given.

display_name.description: The invitee's display name, at most 100 characters.

oneOf.description: The invitee's role; `user` when left out.

JobResponse.description:
A job, as an admin sees it. Its payload is left out: a pending mail's
holds the link it carries.

attempts.description: The attempts it took so far.

last_error.description: Why its last attempt failed, if one did.

run_at.description: When it is due: its next attempt, for a pending job.

oneOf.description: A second factor is needed first.

pending_token.description: The token `POST /auth/2fa/verify` takes with the code.

LoginResponse.description:
What `POST /auth/login` returns: either a real session (`TokenResponse`'s
shape) or, for a two-factor-enabled account, a marker plus the
short-lived token `POST /auth/2fa/verify` needs. Untagged, so each
variant serializes as its own plain object: a client tells them apart by
`access_token` vs `requires_totp`.

MediaResponse.description: A stored file's metadata, as the API answers it.

content_type.description: Detected from the file's bytes, not taken from the upload request.

original_filename.description: The name it was uploaded with, if any.

url.description: Where to fetch the file. It needs the same credentials as any other endpoint.

MessageResponse.description: A message for people, such as `email verified`.

items.description: A `audit_log` row as the API answers it.

per_page.description: The most rows a page holds.

total.description: The rows on every page together.

content_type.description: Detected from the file's bytes, not taken from the upload request.

original_filename.description: The name it was uploaded with, if any.

url.description: Where to fetch the file. It needs the same credentials as any other endpoint.

per_page.description: The most rows a page holds.

total.description: The rows on every page together.

total.description: The rows on every page together.

ResetPasswordDto.description:
`POST /auth/password/reset`'s body: a reset (or invitation) link's
token and the new password.

new_password.description: The new password: 8 to 128 characters, anything allowed.

token.description: The token the mailed link carries (`?token=`).

SortOrder.description:
The direction of a list's sort: `order=asc` or `order=desc`, the
default.

StartUploadDto.description:
`POST /media/uploads`'s body: a file the client will put straight into
the store (engine ADR 0024). Both values are checked against the bytes
when the upload is completed.

content_type.description: The file's type, such as `image/png`: one of `MEDIA_ALLOWED_TYPES`.

filename.description: The file's original name, kept for display and as the download name.

size_bytes.description: The file's size, in bytes: at most `MEDIA_MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES`.

TokenResponse.description: A session: a bearer token and how long it lasts.

access_token.description: The JWT to send as `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>`.

TotpEnabledResponse.description:
Shown exactly once, right after enabling two-factor: only hashes of
these are ever stored.

recovery_codes.description:
Ten single-use `XXXXX-XXXXX` codes, each standing in for an
authenticator code once.

TotpSetupResponse.description:
Everything needed to enroll an authenticator app. Two-factor is not yet
on: the caller confirms a code from the app with `POST /auth/2fa/enable`
first.

provisioning_uri.description: The `otpauth://totp/…` URI the QR code carries.

qr_code_data_uri.description: The QR code of `provisioning_uri`, as a `data:image/svg+xml` URI.

secret.description:
Base32-encoded; lets the user type the secret in by hand if they
cannot scan the QR code.

UpdateProfileDto.description:
`PATCH /users/me`'s body. A field left out keeps its value; the display
name is trimmed, and `null` or an empty one clears it.

display_name.description: The new display name, at most 100 characters.

UpdateUserDto.description:
`PATCH /api/v1/users/{id}`'s body, checked by the rules of `UpdateUser`.
Every field is optional: a field left out keeps its column's value, and
`null` sets a nullable column to `NULL`.

display_name.description:
The new value of the `display_name` column.

Transforms: `trim`.

is_active.description: The new value of the `is_active` column.

oneOf.description: The new value of the `role` column.

UploadTicket.description: `POST /media/uploads`'s answer: where to put the bytes, and until when.

expires_at.description:
When the URL stops working; an upload not completed by then is
removed.

headers.description: The headers to send with the bytes: their `Content-Type`.

media_id.description: The file's id: `POST /media/{media_id}/complete` once the bytes are up.

method.description: The method to send the bytes with: `PUT`.

upload_url.description:
Where to send them: absolute on an S3-compatible store, else relative
to the API (`/api/v1/storage/…`).

UserResponse.description:
A `users` row as the API answers it: the same shape as the `users`
feature's, which this feature may not import.

avatar_url.description:
The profile photo's public, cacheable URL,
`/api/v1/avatars/<file>`, or `null` without one.

email_verified.description: Whether the email address is verified.

has_password.description: Whether the account has a password (an invited one has none yet).

is_active.description: Whether the account may sign in.

VerifyEmailDto.description:
Body for redeeming a link token: email verification and email-change
confirmation.

token.description: The token the mailed link carries (`?token=`).

VerifyTotpDto.description:
`POST /auth/2fa/verify`'s body. `code` accepts either a live 6-digit
authenticator code or an `XXXXX-XXXXX` recovery code.

code.description: An authenticator code or a recovery code.

bearer_auth.description: A JWT the application signed, sent as `Bearer <token>`.
